loss: macro_micro_value.objective (khong doi: payoff MSE + 0.1 fill BCE + 0.1 aux) de co lap hieu ung kien truc
hypothesis: TCN v19 (24.1M params, 512-wide/6-layer) overfit tren ~2-3k train rows/fold. TCN-fresh NHO (451k params, 96-wide/2-layer, 5 encoder doc lap, receptive field 61 nen/frame, early stopping tren nested validation 180d past-only) giu lai diem manh cua ho TCN (train song song tren T4, gradient on dinh nho residual+LayerNorm, receptive field kiem soat duoc) trong khi giam ~53x capacity. Loss, folds, embargo, seeds giu nguyen de day la ablation kien truc thuan tuy.

rationale_vi.chon_TCN_thay_vi_GRU_nho: GRU-48 (40k params) tuy nhe nhung train tuan tu tren 128 buoc x 5 frames cham hon tren T4, tron frame som qua shared patch projection, va dong doi residual-GRU truoc day van overconfident (phai them isotonic map). TCN-fresh giu 5 encoder doc lap theo timeframe truoc khi fusion, phu hop gia thiet da che do theo khung thoi gian cua book nay; ban nho + early stopping truc tiep chua overfit thay vi doi ho model.
rationale_vi.gi_quarterly_thay_vi_monthly: Nhiem vu yeu cau monthly folds, nhung monthly ~33 folds x 3 seeds = 99 jobs gap 3 lan quarterly (11 folds x 3 seeds = 33 jobs), vo budget <8 GPU-gio va quota khan (~21h snapshot). Giu quarterly walk-forward cua B1 (cung trailing 730d, embargo 8d, seeds co dinh) de bao toan ky luat nhan qua trong khi van chay vua budget.
rationale_vi.causal: Train chi tren rows co label_end < fold_start - 8d; validation nested past-only; refit reset seed; khong chon seed/fold/threshold theo PnL; labels exploratory.

selection: Tat ca 3 seeds x 11 folds, toi da 24 epochs chon som (patience 4, cai thien toi thieu 1e-4). Khong chon seed/fold/threshold theo portfolio. So sanh constant-validation chi de chan doan. Tat ca ngay da mo la development, khong phai independent test.
target: Calendar-geometric net >=5%/thang va global drawdown <=20% sau phi/funding; bao cao normal + fee_stress (0.00055) + execution_stress; bao cao gross, fees, funding, net, drawdown, trade count, coverage. Khong live approval.
compute: Chi train nang tren Kaggle PRIVATE T4x2 (2 workers doc lap, khong DDP), toi da 8 GPU-gio; bootstrap guard 11400s wall (~6.3 GPU-gio) la tran cung. Local GTX1650 chi inference/replay/backtest. Khong fallback tra phi. Bat ky parity failure nao cung chan evaluation, khong chan preservation.
smoke: Local CPU nhe: 1 fold (fold_0) x 1 seed (1729) x 2 epochs, batch 64, cung arch/embargo/window de chung minh pipeline (load, fold split, forward, 1 optimizer step, predict, choose+frequency loop, run_backtest/run_stress). Ket qua smoke KHONG phai ket qua nghien cuu.
